lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 001: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: Closed the latent regression carried over from US-002/US-003's handoffs: vendor/check-agent-frontmatter.ts's REQUIRED_TOP_LEVEL_KEYS still required 'model' after US-002 stripped the model: frontmatter line from all 5 .claude/agents/*.md persona files, so `bun vendor/check-agent-frontmatter.ts` (and therefore cam init's runVendoredSmoke('check-agent-frontmatter.ts') step) reported 5 spurious violations. Resolved as a deliberate, documented LOCAL DIVERGENCE from the upstream 'reporter' vendored copy (not by waiting on an upstream fix in a repo this PRD has no access to): dropped 'model' from REQUIRED_TOP_LEVEL_KEYS (check #6, the shape-validate-when-present rule, is unchanged), documented the divergence in 3 places -- a header comment in vendor/check-agent-frontmatter.ts, a new 'Local divergences from upstream' section in vendor/README.md, and a locking regression test asserting the smoke exits 0 for a fixture with no model: key. Re-ran `bun run embed-vendor` to regenerate src/vendor/_generated.ts (the actually-consumed embedded copy) and confirmed `bun vendor/check-agent-frontmatter.ts` now exits 0 with '5 agent file(s) ok.' against the repo's own .claude/agents/*.md. Any FUTURE re-vendor of check-agent-frontmatter.ts from upstream reporter must re-apply this patch (or the divergence must be upstreamed to reporter first) before running embed-vendor:check -- the header comment and README section are the durable markers for that. Quality gates all green: typecheck 0 errors, bun test 4342 pass / 0 fail, check:all full spine (test/embed-vendor/lint/file-size/debt-markers/version-skips/coverage/dead-code/dup/ci-parity) clean.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Docs' 'Supported frontmatter fields' table confirms only `name` and `description` are required (Yes); `model` is listed as No (optional) and 'Defaults to inherit' when omitted. Confirms the vendored smoke's prior REQUIRED_TOP_LEVEL_KEYS (requiring model) was over-strict relative to the real Claude Code loader contract, and that this story's fix (dropping model from the required set) now matches upstream product behavior exactly.
